messages:
Aisha: quick morning q  we0 launching webinar + trial funnel next wed. need paid search + retarget plan that's tight on budget but keeps lead quality. any short playbooks?
Tom: keep top keywords exact + phrase to prevent waste, expand broad-match only in day 4+ if volume low. set campaign-level negative keywords from our last launch list.
Ravi: budget suggestion: $1.5k prospecting/day US consolidated for first 5 days, $800 retarget/day. use bid cap to control CPCs.
Clara: retarget creative: 2 short testimonials (5-7 words), 1 product gif. rotate 12h for first 48h, then 24h. include CTA: "reserve seat" for webinar and "start trial" for retarget.
ads-bot: creative-check: 2 testimonials uploaded, 1 gif pending.
Aisha: routing: webhook to go/marketing-webhook, include utm_source=paidsearch, utm_medium=cpc, campaign=webinar_may. SDR tag: inbound_priority=high for trial signups.
Tom: pacing rule: throttle prospecting spend to evenly hit daily budget using time-of-day hour pacing; frontload 60% in hours 8-18 PT.
Ravi: add performance guardrail: if CTR < 0.5% for 36h, pause low-quality exact matches and reallocate to phrase.
Clara: creative QA: small copy tweak: add social proof stat to gif frame 2.
Aisha: ok let's sync again after creatives are live. will drop final sheet link here.
